customer: hey so i got an apraisal apointment coming up for my station wagon, what do i need to bring with me? my wife is also on the title but shes working that day, does that matter? also still paying off a loan on it if that changes anything
agent: Thanks for reaching out! Per our article "What to bring to your appraisal appointment," please bring a valid photo ID for every owner listed on the title, the current registration, all keys and remotes, and the odometer statement (form NW-ODO-1), which you can also fill in at the store. Since you still have a loan, bring your payoff letter instead of the title (see "Getting a payoff letter"), and because your wife can't come, please check "When more than one person owns the car." Plan for the appointment to take about an hour.
